rules: Candidate relations are manual case/recipe inspection, not an exhaustive proof of semantic disjointness.
No script/name-count dedup is sufficient: differing expected effects, fixtures, provider/profile, frozen source and aliases matter.
python/python3, declare/typeset, mapfile/readarray share semantic intents within breadth; their separate name-compatible dispatch evidence cannot be inflated into independent capabilities.

A future union requires one aligned frozen product/dependency/profile, predeclared equivalence classes and exact common predicates, with diagnostic, informational and lifecycle-failing rows separate. No such union is computed here.
